faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery Si6 use?
faqLeft.a: The Discovery Si6 uses the AJ-V6 — a 3.0-litre petrol V6. It was fitted to both the D3 (2004–2009) and D4 (2009–2016) generations.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery Si6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery Si6?
faqLeft.a: The Discovery Si6 uses the AJ-V6 engine code across all production years. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ-V6 Discovery Si6 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pumps and gaskets as standard on every Discovery Si6 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery Si6 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery Si6 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery Si6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
